Serve the model viewer

cdrgam_cli_viz.Rd

Starts, reports, or stops the current user's browser viewer for completed fits under the configured root. The viewer plots effect lines, with several lines from any fits on one plot, and two-axis effect surfaces. Each line or surface selects a term, the axes that vary, and fixed values for the remaining axes. A reference can be subtracted from each line or surface; an empty reference field leaves that predictor at the model default. Estimates and pointwise intervals are on the linear-predictor scale.

Usage

cdrgam_cli_viz(cdrgam_root = NULL, stop = FALSE, restart = FALSE,
  local = FALSE, port = NULL, cpus = NULL, memory = NULL, time = NULL,
  partition = NULL, qos = NULL, wait = 120, browse = NULL)

Arguments

cdrgam_root

Configured CDR-GAM root.

stop

Cancel the recorded viewer job instead of starting one.

restart

Cancel the recorded viewer job, then start a new one.

local

Serve from this process even on a Slurm-configured root.

port

Port to listen on. The default is a stable per-user port, or the next free port after it.

cpus, memory, time, partition, qos

Slurm resource overrides for the viewer job. The defaults are one CPU, 16G, and 12 hours, with the partition, account, and QOS taken from the root configuration.

wait

Seconds to wait for a submitted job to start serving.

browse

Whether a local viewer opens the default browser. The default opens it when the session is interactive or standard output is a terminal. A Slurm viewer never opens one.

Value

The active server record, invisibly, or NULL when the job has not started within wait seconds or the server ran in the foreground.

Details

On a root whose scheduler is Slurm, the viewer runs in a Slurm job, and later calls by the same user reuse that job. Otherwise, or with local = TRUE, it serves from this process until interrupted, on any platform, and prints its address. A local viewer has no job, so stop and restart are errors; interrupt it and start it again instead. A Slurm viewer listens on all interfaces of its node, without authentication, so other users who can reach the node can also open it. The printed ssh command forwards the port through the login host named by the CDRGAM_VIZ_GATEWAY environment variable, or through the invoking host when it is unset. A local viewer listens only on the loopback interface. Viewer state, including the job record and server log, is kept under .cdrgam/viewers/ in the root.

In a Slurm viewer, the Refresh data button rescans for completed fits and reloads fits whose results changed, and the Restart server button restarts the server inside the same job with the currently installed code, on the same port.

The viewer requires the optional packages shiny, bslib, plotly, jsonlite, and later.
